desc:
🦖🥚Who stole the dino? STEAL A DINO 🥚🦖

Sneak into the dino corridor, grab the rarest eggs and RUN! 🏃💨
Every zone is guarded by a sleeping dinosaur… steal its egg and it WAKES UP and hunts you down! 😴➡️😡

🔥 Reach the lobby to keep your egg
🐣 Hatch eggs into 49+ dinos — Common to CELESTIAL ✨
🏠 Raise them in your own biome, feed them and level them up 💰
🏃 Farm SPEED on the treadmill to outrun the guardians
🏏 Use the Bat and the Slap to knock eggs out of other players' hands!
🔄 Rebirth to unlock stronger treadmills and even rarer dinos
🎁 Daily rewards, codes and mutations 🌈

Can you steal the Celestial egg… and survive? 😈

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to help the game grow — new dinos coming soon!
